calls.title: Eddie Aguilar and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting focused on strengthening the partnership between Spiro and Growth Book to drive mutual growth through integration, co-marketing, and improved client support. Spiro highlighted its strategic push for Growth Book partnerships and its role in helping clients integrate experimentation tools. Issues identified, such as provisioning gaps and communication challenges with Growth Book, pointed to the need for better coordination. Plans for co-marketing included creating joint case studies, a partner directory, and potential collaboration in upcoming events. Spiro's expertise in technical support for experiments and migration from other platforms underscores its value to enterprises. The meeting also clarified roles within Spiro's sales structure to enhance collaboration on joint customer opportunities.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, experimentation, Adobe Target, Spiro, AI integration, co-marketing
